articles.title: FBI Confirms North Korean Hackers Responsible for $6 Billion+ Binance Attack
articles.summary:
The Federal Bureau of Investigation has confirmed that North Korean hackers stole more than $6 billion in virtual assets from Binance on or about October 29, 2026. The agency tracks the activity as TraderTraitor, linking the cryptocurrency theft to an operation previously blamed for major attacks against digital asset platforms. articles.title: Hacktober – Cyberattack Wave Hits PHP, Node.js, Binance, LiteLLM, Pentagon, and a Few More
articles.summary:
October brought a heavy run of cybersecurity disclosures involving cryptocurrency exchanges, web servers, AI tools, software packages, government records, and grocery chains. Binance investigated billions of dollars in unauthorized transactions, PHP issued emergency fixes, and a malicious LiteLLM release put developer credentials at risk. Other incidents involved Railway, OpenCode, Polymarket, Coinbase, Cursor, eMudhra, and Capcom. […]
